summary: Geometry Dash entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Geometry Dash

primary.why: Geometry Dash exists on mobile and PC. The Steam PC version is the best capture/control route, while mobile remains the original touch platform.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam version on Windows and record the exact game version, level, and whether user-created content is included.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch version and whether official levels or user-created levels are being archived.
